title: Global Banking Cloud Migration
challenge: GlobalBank was running 15-year-old on-premise infrastructure across 3 data centres with increasing failure rates and spiralling maintenance costs.
solution: We designed and executed a phased multi-cloud migration to AWS and Azure, implementing a fault-tolerant active-active architecture across regions with zero-downtime cutover windows.
outcome: Achieved 99.999% uptime SLA, reduced infrastructure costs by 42%, cut average incident resolution time from 4 hours to 9 minutes, and eliminated 3 legacy data centres.

title: Agentic Supply Chain Optimiser
challenge: Logix Global was losing millions annually due to manual routing decisions, reactive inventory management, and siloed data across 40+ logistics hubs.
solution: We deployed a network of LLM-powered agent systems that ingest real-time data from sensors, APIs, and ERP systems to make autonomous routing and inventory decisions.
outcome: Delivered 30% reduction in transport inefficiencies, $4.2M in annual savings, and reduced average order fulfilment time from 3.2 days to 1.8 days.

title: Zero-Trust Security Overhaul
challenge: MediCore had experienced two data breaches in 18 months, exposing patient records. Their perimeter-based security model was fundamentally inadequate for their distributed workforce.
solution: We designed and implemented a comprehensive zero-trust architecture including identity-aware proxies, micro-segmentation, privileged access management, and a 24/7 SOC with SIEM.
outcome: Zero security incidents in 18 months post-implementation. Achieved HIPAA and ISO 27001 compliance. Reduced mean time to detect threats from 72 hours to under 4 minutes.

title: CI/CD Pipeline Transformation
challenge: TechCorp's development teams were deploying twice a month due to a fragile, manual release process. Failed deployments required weekend rollbacks and caused significant revenue loss.
solution: We rebuilt their entire delivery pipeline using GitHub Actions, Terraform, ArgoCD, and Kubernetes. Introduced trunk-based development, automated testing gates, and blue-green deployments.
outcome: Increased deployment frequency from 2 per month to 40 per day. Reduced deployment failure rate from 23% to 0.8%. Change lead time fell from 3 weeks to under 4 hours.

title: Real-Time Data Platform
challenge: AlphaCo was making merchandising and pricing decisions based on data that was 24–48 hours stale, causing millions in lost revenue from missed demand signals.
solution: We built a real-time streaming platform using Apache Kafka, Spark Streaming, and dbt, backed by a Snowflake data warehouse and Tableau dashboards for business users.
outcome: Replaced all 24-hour batch reports with real-time streaming dashboards. Inventory accuracy improved from 71% to 97%. Promotional uplift improved by 18% within the first quarter.

title: Enterprise ERP Modernisation
challenge: Innovate was running a 20-year-old monolithic ERP system that couldn't integrate with modern APIs, required costly proprietary licences, and had crippling scalability limits.
solution: We performed a full strangler-fig migration — incrementally replacing the monolith with event-driven microservices built on FastAPI (Python), gRPC, and a Kubernetes-hosted service mesh.
outcome: Delivered a cloud-native ERP with 12 microservices, integrated with 8 third-party systems. System throughput increased 15x. Annual licence costs reduced by $1.3M.

title: Digital Banking App Redesign
challenge: ClearBank's mobile banking app had a 2.1-star rating with 8,000+ negative reviews citing confusing navigation, inaccessible design, and an outdated visual identity.
solution: We conducted 60+ user interviews, rebuilt the information architecture from first principles, created a comprehensive design system, and delivered a fully accessible (WCAG AA) React Native app.
outcome: App store rating improved from 2.1 to 4.7 stars. Net Promoter Score jumped from 28 to 74. Daily active users increased by 41%.

title: AI-Powered Document Intelligence
challenge: LexCorp's legal teams spent an average of 14 hours reviewing each contract for risks, clauses, and compliance issues — a bottleneck that limited the firm's ability to scale.
solution: We built a RAG-powered document intelligence platform using GPT-4 fine-tuned on legal corpora, integrated with their document management system for automatic ingestion and structured extraction.
outcome: Reduced average contract review time from 14 hours to 90 minutes. Clause extraction accuracy at 97.3%. Firm handled 3x more contracts with the same legal headcount.

title: Kubernetes Platform Engineering
challenge: StreamVault's video streaming platform was collapsing under peak load — weekend spikes caused 4–6 hour outages, resulting in churn and reputational damage.
solution: Re-architected the platform on Kubernetes with horizontal pod autoscaling, a global CDN layer, and event-driven microservices for transcoding and delivery. Implemented chaos engineering practices.
outcome: Platform now handles 10M concurrent users with sub-200ms latency globally. Zero unplanned outages in 12 months post-launch. Infrastructure cost per stream reduced by 38%.

title: B2B E-Commerce Marketplace
challenge: TradeHub relied on a severely outdated Magento implementation that couldn't support complex tiered pricing algorithms and custom quote workflows necessary for B2B transactions.
solution: Developed a custom headless e-commerce architecture using Next.js/React and Node.js microservices. Integrated advanced Elasticsearch, Stripe B2B APIs, and ERP synchronisation.
outcome: Supported $2B GMV processing within 6 months of launch. Page load times fell by 80%. B2B conversion rate increased by 22% due to streamlined quote-to-order workflows.

title: Healthcare Data Lake Consolidation
challenge: National Care Network acquired 14 regional clinics over 5 years, resulting in 42 disjointed EMR systems making unified patient records impossible to maintain securely.
solution: Engineered a secure AWS Data Lake adopting Lakehouse architecture (Databricks). Utilised AWS Glue for ETL, anonymizing PII before analytics ingestion.
outcome: Achieved single pane-of-glass patient history across the full network. Tripled the speed of generating quarterly compliance reports while remaining fully HIPAA compliant.

title: Global SOC Implementation
challenge: ConnectTel faced growing volumetric DDoS attacks and sophisticated spear-phishing campaigns against their executive tier with only an outsourced tier-1 IT desk handling alerts.
solution: Built a bespoke Security Operations Center (SOC) framework backed by Splunk SIEM, automated playbooks via SOAR for rapid triage, and integrated threat intelligence feeds.
outcome: Blocked 4 major intrusion attempts in the first quarter. Automated 68% of initial alert triage, freeing analysts to focus on advanced persistent threats.
